dyslexia.label: Dyslexia-friendly mode
dyslexia.hint: Larger text, more spacing, less visual clutter

curriculumProfile.label: Curriculum track (grade 10+)
curriculumProfile.hint: Optional. If you're in grade 9 or below, skip this step.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: Set up your local learning space. No account, no real name — your data stays on this device.

llm.apiKeyHint: Stored only on this device. Never uploaded or committed.
llm.cloudWarning: Cloud provider: your prompts and retrieved text will be sent to an external service.

dashboard.title: Subject dashboard
dashboard.noData: No activity yet — start a diagnostic to see progress.
dashboard.readinessEstimateNote: estimate from practice — no real mock exam for this subject yet

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic test
diagnostic.intro: A short test across topics to find your weak areas. Answer briefly; this is not graded.
diagnostic.question: Question {{n}} of {{total}}
diagnostic.finishBody: We updated your topic mastery. Weak areas will be recommended more often.

practice.title: Practice
practice.insufficient: Local materials do not contain enough information for this question.
practice.corpusEmpty: This subject has no knowledge base in this build. The public repository ships without the copyrighted textbook packs for chemistry, mathematics and Russian — regenerate them locally with npm run seed, or load the synthetic demo with npm run seed:demo. See the README and docs/JUDGE_REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
practice.timerBreak: You've studied for a while. Take a short break.

modelLab.title: Model lab
modelLab.intro: Compare providers and models on the same question.

exportScreen.title: Export for teacher
exportScreen.intro: Export an anonymous JSON report. It contains progress, mastery, weak topics and model metrics — no personal data.

settings.title: Settings
settings.embModelNote: The model name comes from the downloaded subject pack; this only selects where it is served.
settings.resetConfirm: This deletes all local progress on this device. Continue?
settings.ollamaDetected: Local Ollama detected. Use it for grading instead of the cloud?
settings.ovmsDetected: Local OpenVINO Model Server detected. Switch chat and embeddings to it?
settings.corpusRegenNote: Chemistry, mathematics and Russian ship with no knowledge base in the public build (the source textbooks are copyrighted). Run npm run seed with a local corpus to regenerate them, or npm run seed:demo for a small synthetic demo. See docs/JUDGE_REPRODUCIBILITY.md.

privacy.localOnly: Your data stays on this device by default.

embeddings.unavailable: The embedding model is unavailable, so material search is off. Start Ollama with bge-m3 (ollama pull bge-m3) and try again, or switch this subject's pack to the offline mode.

stats.title: Model statistics
stats.intro: Aggregated performance across all recorded model runs (practice and model lab).
stats.empty: No model runs recorded yet. Use Practice or the Model Lab to generate metrics.

exam.title: Mock exam
exam.noPaste: Pasting is disabled during the exam — type your answer.
exam.tabWarning: You left the exam tab {{count}}/{{max}}. After {{max}} the exam is submitted automatically.
exam.noPaper: No mock exam is available for this subject yet.

rescue.title: Recover exam points
rescue.intro: Take the diagnostic exam once, then get a short, targeted plan to recover points before the retake.
rescue.alreadySafe: You are already above the safety target. Use a short consolidation round or Test B instead.
rescue.recoverableZoneTitle: Where more points are easiest to find
rescue.testBIntro: A fresh, unpracticed variant — checks whether the trained skills transfer.
